protectedNavPages.baselineMainText: Hicks Consulting Mental health support for high-achieving women and healthier organizations. Grounded care. Intentional healing. Room to exhale. Hicks Consulting helps individuals work through burnout, anxiety, people-pleasing, boundary challenges, and emotional exhaustion while helping organizations build more trauma-informed, emotionally sustainable people systems. Led by Monika Hicks, LCSW, Hicks Consulting brings licensed clinical insight into two clear pathways: warm individual support for emotional wellness and strategic mental health trainings for teams, leaders, and institutions. Work With Me (Individuals) Book a Training (Organizations) Individual therapy Coaching support Organizational trainings Keynote speaking Choose your path Support for individuals. Strategy for organizations. Hicks Consulting serves two distinct audiences through one grounded mental health brand: private support for individuals and professional training for teams, leaders, and institutions. For Individuals Seeking Healing & Support Therapy and coaching for women who are tired of holding everything together. If you are high-functioning on the outside but exhausted, anxious, overextended, or disconnected from your own needs, Hicks Consulting offers a grounded space to slow down, feel supported, and rebuild from the inside out. This pathway supports women navigating burnout, anxiety, people-pleasing, emotional exhaustion, boundaries, and the pressure to keep performing while quietly falling apart. Work With Me (Individuals) For Organizations & Teams Mental health trainings and keynote speaking for organizations that want healthier people systems. For hospitals, nonprofits, schools, healthcare systems, and mission-driven organizations, Hicks Consulting delivers practical mental health education that supports burnout reduction, trauma-informed culture, staff retention, and emotional sustainability. This pathway is designed for leaders who need professional, outcome-oriented training that helps teams understand stress, strengthen boundaries, communicate more effectively, and sustain the work without burning out. Request a Training Individual support You do not have to keep surviving at the expense of yourself. For high-achieving women, burnout can look like competence, over-responsibility, perfectionism, people-pleasing, and silently carrying more than anyone realizes. Hicks Consulting offers therapy and coaching support for women who are ready to stop abandoning themselves, rebuild emotional steadiness, strengthen boundaries, and create a life that is not powered by exhaustion. The work is warm, direct, and grounded. It is for the woman who has been functioning for everyone else and is ready to feel more present, supported, and whole in her own life. When clinically necessary, Hicks Consulting can also provide referrals for medication management support. Book Individual Support Explore Therapy Organizational training Workforce mental health is no longer a wellness extra. It is a stability issue. Hicks Consulting helps organizations address burnout, compassion fatigue, trauma exposure, boundaries, emotional sustainability, and healthier workplace culture through strategic trainings and keynote speaking. When staff are overwhelmed, emotionally depleted, or unsupported, organizations feel it through turnover, disengagement, conflict, absenteeism, and declining trust. Mental health education gives teams shared language, practical tools, and a more sustainable way to work together. Trainings are designed for real-world institutions that need more than inspiration. They support workforce stability, trauma-informed systems, employee wellbeing, leadership awareness, and healthier people operations. Bring Hicks Consulting to Your Organization View Training Services Clinical authority Led by a licensed mental health professional. Monika Hicks, LCSW brings clinical training, therapeutic insight, and a grounded understanding of how stress, burnout, anxiety, boundaries, and emotional patterns show up in real life. Her individual work centers emotional steadiness, self-trust, stronger boundaries, medication management referral when clinically necessary, and sustainable change for clients who are ready to move beyond survival mode. Organizational expertise Built for teams, leaders, and institutions. Hicks Consulting also translates mental health expertise into professional trainings, workshops, and keynote presentations for organizations that want healthier people systems. The approach is practical, trauma-informed, and designed for workplace realities: emotional labor, burnout risk, communication strain, leadership pressure, and staff sustainability. Signature trainings Premium mental health trainings for modern organizations. Programs can be adapted for staff development, leadership retreats, wellness initiatives, conferences, schools, healthcare teams, nonprofits, and institutional events. Burnout-Proofing the Workplace A practical training on recognizing burnout risk, reducing emotional depletion, and building healthier team rhythms before exhaustion becomes turnover. Trauma-Informed Leadership in Real-World Settings A strategic workshop for leaders and teams who need to understand how stress and trauma affect communication, trust, performance, and culture. Emotional Sustainability for High-Responsibility Teams A workforce development session for care-heavy, mission-driven, or high-pressure teams carrying complex emotional demands. Boundaries, Communication, and Workplace Wellbeing A practical training that helps staff and leaders strengthen communication, reduce resentment, and protect capacity without sacrificing care. From Compassion Fatigue to Sustainable Service A focused program for organizations whose teams support others while managing chronic stress, crisis exposure, or emotional labor. The Human Side of Retention An executive-level conversation on how emotional safety, burnout prevention, and trauma-informed people systems support workforce stability. Request a Training Meet Monika A grounded clinical voice with real-world organizational range. Hicks Consulting is led by Monika Hicks, LCSW, a licensed mental health professional who supports individual healing while helping organizations understand the human side of burnout, trauma exposure, emotional labor, and staff sustainability. The brand is warm enough for personal healing work and structured enough for institutional training spaces that need clarity, professionalism, and practical takeaways. protectedNavPages.baselineMainText: Virtual therapy Therapy for women who are ready to stop surviving their own life. Therapy offers a supportive space to work through burnout, boundaries, stress, life transitions, and emotional healing. This work may feel especially meaningful for people who are used to holding everything together and are ready for a more honest, intentional way of living, including many women who have spent a long time carrying more than they should. Book a Consult What therapy can support When high functioning starts costing too much. Therapy may support emotional overload, burnout, depression-related heaviness, anxiety-related patterns, self-esteem, boundaries, relationship strain, grief, life transitions, and the exhaustion of being the dependable one in every room. Virtual format Care is online only. Individual counseling through Hicks Consulting is virtual. This keeps the therapy path clear, private, and accessible for clients located in Tennessee. Fit This may be a fit if you are ready to name what is no longer working. Therapy is not about proving how strong you are. It is a place to slow down, listen more closely, and understand what your emotions, patterns, relationships, and body may be asking you to face. You feel emotionally tired even when life looks fine You overextend and then resent how much you carry You want culturally aware support without overexplaining You are ready to build healthier patterns Ready to start? Use the SimplePractice link to request a consult or book available services through Hicks Consulting’s secure EHR system. Book Through SimplePractice

protectedNavPages.baselineMainText: Virtual coaching Coaching for the next version of your life. Coaching offers non-clinical support for people who want help with boundaries, confidence, burnout recovery, self-trust, decision-making, and life transitions. It is designed for people who feel ready for change and want a thoughtful space to reflect, get clear, and move forward with more intention. Coaching can be especially helpful when you are not in crisis, but you do know you want support, structure, and a different way of moving through this season of your life. Book Coaching What coaching supports Decision-making, boundaries, and self-trust. Coaching may help with work-life alignment, identity shifts, leadership pressure, emotional wellness habits, communication patterns, confidence, and the process of choosing differently after years of over-functioning. Who it helps For high-functioning women who need room to be honest. Coaching can be especially helpful for women who look capable on the outside but feel stretched thin internally and want more clarity, steadier self-trust, and more intentional next steps. Therapy vs Coaching Therapy supports clinical mental health care for people who want a deeper space to work through emotional pain, stress, patterns, relationships, burnout, or healing that feels hard to navigate alone. Coaching is non-clinical support for people who want clarity, accountability, reflection, and practical help as they move through transitions, decision-making, boundaries, confidence, or next steps. Therapy Clinical mental health support Deeper emotional healing and patterns Support for stress, burnout, relationships, and mental health care For people who want a therapeutic space to process what feels hard to carry alone Coaching Non-clinical support Clarity, accountability, and practical next steps Support for transitions, confidence, boundaries, and intentional change For people who feel ready to move differently and want structure along the way Both paths offer support, but they serve different needs. If you are unsure where to begin, start with the secure booking link and choose the option that feels closest to your current need. Read the Therapy vs Coaching White Paper

protectedNavPages.baselineMainText: Virtual support groups Guided group support for people who do not want to heal in isolation. Virtual support groups offer a guided space to reflect, connect, and grow with others who may be carrying similar experiences. These groups are more than casual conversation. They are intentionally led spaces where participants can feel supported, hear different perspectives, practice new tools, and feel less alone. Ask About Virtual Groups Guided spaces for shared reflection, connection, and emotional wellness. Group inquiry Inquire about virtual support groups Share what kind of group support you’re looking for. You do not need to know the exact group name or format yet — Hicks Consulting will review your inquiry and follow up with next steps. First Name Last Name Email Phone Number What kind of group support are you interested in? What would make a group feel useful or supportive for you right now? Do you have any scheduling preferences or availability constraints? Is there anything Hicks Consulting should know before following up? Submit Group Inquiry What group support is Connection with structure. A group session brings multiple people into a guided support setting. The facilitator helps hold the conversation, protect the tone of the space, and keep the group focused on emotional insight, skill-building, and mutual respect. Why people choose groups Sometimes healing needs witnesses. Group support can help people feel less isolated, recognize shared patterns, gain perspective, and practice being honest in a space where other people are also doing meaningful emotional work. Fit You may be a fit for a group if... Group support can be especially helpful for women who feel overwhelmed, overextended, in transition, or in need of both community and professional guidance. You want support but do not want to feel alone in the process You benefit from hearing how other people name similar struggles You want a guided space, not an unstructured forum You are willing to participate respectfully and protect confidentiality Group vs individual support Different formats support different needs. Individual therapy gives one-on-one clinical attention. Groups offer shared reflection, community, perspective, and a chance to practice connection in real time. Some people use both formats at different seasons. What to expect Virtual, guided, and respectful. Groups may include topic discussion, reflection prompts, shared experiences, practical tools, and space to notice patterns. Not every group is right for every person, so interest and fit are handled thoughtfully. Group questions Are groups therapy? Some groups may be therapeutic or therapist-led, but the format and purpose depend on the specific group. Hicks Consulting will clarify the structure before enrollment. Are groups virtual? Yes. Group support through Hicks Consulting is positioned as virtual unless a specific organization separately arranges an in-person training. How do I learn about upcoming groups? Email Hicks Consulting to express interest and ask about current or upcoming group options. Ask About Virtual Groups

protectedNavPages.baselineMainText: Organizational training In-person mental health trainings and keynote speaking for organizations that want healthier people systems. Hicks Consulting offers in-person trainings and keynote speaking for organizations that want practical, thoughtful support around mental health, emotional wellness, burnout, boundaries, and healthier workplace culture. Monika Hicks brings both clinical insight and real-world practicality to conversations about how people work, lead, communicate, and care for themselves and each other. Inquire about Organizational Training Training focus Practical mental health education for real workplaces. These sessions are designed for organizations looking for more than inspiration alone. The focus is on helping people better recognize stress, strengthen emotional awareness, and build healthier ways of relating at work. Mental health awareness Build shared language around emotional wellness, stress, support, and how mental health shows up at work. Burnout and compassion fatigue Support teams in care-heavy, leadership-heavy, or emotionally demanding environments. Boundaries and self-care Move self-care from a slogan into practical skills for sustainability and healthier communication. Emotional intelligence Help teams increase self-awareness, empathy, regulation, and more thoughtful conflict navigation. Who this is for Teams, leaders, and institutions that need grounded support. Trainings can support workplaces, nonprofits, schools, healthcare-adjacent teams, women-centered organizations, faith-connected spaces, and staff groups carrying high emotional loads. The audience may include both men and women; the work is rooted in practical mental health education, not one-on-one therapy. What to expect Calm facilitation with useful takeaways. Organizations can expect a thoughtful session that respects the room, avoids shame-based messaging, and gives people language and tools they can actually use. Trainings can be adapted for staff development, wellness programming, leadership conversations, and special events. Inquiry process Use the inquiry form to share your organization, event details, training needs, and speaker expectations. Once you complete it, your team can send a more complete request without extra back-and-forth at the start. Inquire about Organizational Training

protectedNavPages.baselineMainText: About Meet Monika Hicks, LCSW Hicks Consulting helps Black women heal beyond survival, break unhealthy cycles, and build healthier, more fulfilling lives through virtual therapy, coaching, and mental health support. I am a purpose-driven mental health consultant committed to helping women heal beyond survival, break unhealthy cycles, and live with more intention, balance, and freedom. “My mission in life is not merely to survive, but to thrive, and to do so with some passion, some compassion, some humor, and some style.” — Maya Angelou The work Built with Black women in mind. Open to people seeking grounded support. Monika earned her Bachelor of Science degree in Clinical Psychology from Middle Tennessee State University, followed by a Master of Science in Social Work from the University of Tennessee Knoxville in 2017. With over a decade of experience as a mental health provider in various settings, she brings a wealth of diverse experience to her practice. As the owner of Hicks Consulting PLLC, Monika practices as an independent Licensed Clinical Social Worker in Tennessee. Her services include individual counseling, virtual support groups, and community and organizational workshops. Balancing her roles as a career woman, wife, mother, and ministry leader, Monika is particularly passionate about supporting African American women who identify as “A Strong Black Woman.” Grounded in her strong Christian faith, she feels called to uplift and support individuals through times of transition. Monika is affectionately known as a mindset shifter. Using Solution Focused Therapy, Monika’s practice is dedicated to helping those experiencing depression, anxiety, low self-esteem, relationship issues, and the challenges of balancing multiple responsibilities. She is committed to destigmatizing mental health and counseling by creating therapeutic safe spaces. Beyond her professional commitments, Monika is a devoted wife and mother of two. In her free time, she enjoys international travel, trying new restaurants, and dancing like no one is watching. Clinical lens Steady, practical, emotionally aware support. Monika’s work centers healing beyond survival, emotional intelligence, boundaries, self-trust, burnout recovery, and healthier relationship patterns. Her style is warm and direct, with an emphasis on helping people make decisions that support the life they actually want to live. Press Featured by Memphis Voyager. The interview shares more about Monika’s background, her business story, and the experiences that shaped Hicks Consulting. Read the Interview

It helps you sort whether therapy, coaching, or both may be the right next step based on what feels most pressing right now. 1. Which feels most true lately? I feel emotionally overloaded and it is affecting daily life. I need clarity, structure, or support with how I am moving through a season. 2. How long has this been building? Long enough that it feels hard to shake on my own. It feels tied to a season, decision, or growth point. 3. What keeps showing up? Exhaustion, irritability, shutdown, or emotional heaviness. Boundaries, confidence, transition, or work-life strain. 4. Are you mostly looking for... Licensed mental health support. Non-clinical support and guided reflection. 5. Does this affect relationships, sleep, focus, or daily functioning? Yes, noticeably. Not in a major way, but I still want support. 6. Where are you located? Tennessee Outside Tennessee 7. What support area feels closest? Stress, burnout, overwhelm Boundaries, self-trust, transition, voice 8. Are you mainly trying to recover, process, and feel steadier? Yes I am mainly trying to move differently and make better decisions. 9. Does the Strong Black Woman role feel heavy right now? Yes, deeply Somewhat, but mostly as a lifestyle or leadership issue 10.
